Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: production-ready chibi desktop pet turnaround sheet with actual transparent background.
Create EXACTLY THREE full-body views of the SAME SINGLE character: FRONT at left, STRICT LEFT SIDE PROFILE facing screen-left at middle, BACK at right. One row, wide 3:2 or 2:1 canvas. The three separate views must not overlap; leave at least 8% canvas width between silhouettes. Same head size, body size, costume, height, ground baseline and camera elevation in all three views. Character is approximately 2.5 heads tall: adorable round face, big expressive eyes, compact tiny torso, small hands and shoes, modest nonsexual proportions. Natural relaxed standing, empty hands, arms slightly away from body. Whole hair, ears, horns, wings, tails, clothes and shoes visible, generous safety margins. Absolutely NO labels, letters, numbers, logo captions, watermark, frames, panels, shadows, ground, patterns or scenery. Do not draw a checkerboard. This is a clean transparent game asset.
Reference image 1: original character's detailed three-view sheet, use for character identity and front/side/back structure, but CHANGE adult proportions to chibi.
Reference image 2: four-character CHIBI STYLE GUIDE. Use ONLY the named character from this board for its final chibi appearance, uniform clean anime cel shading and line quality. Do not include any other character from the board. Match this selected chibi design closely across all three views. Simplify tiny filigree without losing the important costume color blocks. Eyes relaxed and open in front/profile, mouth closed with a slight smile. Back view has no facial features.
Keep the originally asymmetric accessories attached to their correct anatomical sides; do not mirror them just to make views fit. True side profile and true back, not three frontal poses. Preserve exact number and root attachments of the character's ears, horns, wings and tail. No temporary props, no speech, no particles.
